verdict.rationale: Windows docs mention Copilot integration ('Get work done faster with Copilot inside your favorite Microsoft apps like Word, Excel, and PowerPoint') and Windows AI APIs/AI Foundry toolkit for Copilot+ PCs, suggesting some AI-driven assistance is present in the OS ecosystem. However, evidence is thin and mostly developer-facing (building AI apps) rather than concrete end-user proof of the OS itself surfacing insights/suggestions from a user's own data (e.g., Recall-style analysis). Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of Windows Copilot analyzing user's local files/data and generating actionable insights, independent corroboration of this working in practice, and detail on scope/limits of the feature.
